# quadlet_deployment (Resource)

A named deployment on a rootless Podman host: Quadlets, native user units and configuration files. Any file, trigger or activation policy change activates the whole deployment. One host record tracks ownership and the successfully applied revision. Files declared in configuration become managed, including existing files. Overlapping deployments are rejected. Systemd and Quadlet interpret drop-ins. File replacements are individually atomic; a failed activation is retried by a subsequent apply. Destroy stops recorded units and removes recorded files; application data, volumes and networks stay. Systemd dependencies and unit commands may affect other workloads and remain the author's responsibility.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "quadlet_deployment" "app" {
  name = "app"
  files = {
    "containers/systemd/app.container" = <<-UNIT
      [Container]
      Image=docker.io/library/nginx:stable
      Volume=%E/app:/etc/nginx/conf.d:ro
      [Install]
      WantedBy=default.target
    UNIT
    "app/default.conf"                 = "server { listen 80; }\n"
  }

  restart = ["app.service"]
}

resource "quadlet_deployment" "worker" {
  name = "worker"
  files = {
    "systemd/user/worker.service" = <<-UNIT
      [Service]
      ExecStart=/bin/sh %E/worker/run.sh
      [Install]
      WantedBy=default.target
    UNIT
    "worker/run.sh"               = "exec sleep infinity\n"
  }

  restart = ["worker.service"]
  enable  = ["worker.service"]
  triggers = {
    configuration_revision = "1"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `files` (Map of String) Path relative to ~/.config to content. Configuration lands in the state; reference secrets instead of embedding them.
- `name` (String) Deployment name, unique for the host user. Use 1–64 letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens, starting with a letter or digit. Changing it replaces the deployment.

### Optional

- `enable` (Set of String) Owned native units to enable at boot. Defaults to no units; removing a previously enabled unit removes its boot links without stopping it. Quadlets use their own [Install] section.
- `restart` (Set of String) Owned units to start or restart whenever any deployment file, trigger or activation policy changes. Defaults to no units. Must not overlap try_restart.
- `triggers` (Map of String) External revisions, including secret installation revisions. Any change activates the deployment. Values are stored in state; never supply secret contents.
- `try_restart` (Set of String) Owned units to restart only if active, on the same deployment-wide changes. Use for socket-activated services. Defaults to no units.

### Read-Only

- `applied_revision` (String) Revision committed after files and units were applied successfully. Empty while recovery is pending; the next plan schedules an update even if the files already match.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `units` (Set of String) Owned services, timers, sockets and targets, discovered from the native files and the host's Quadlet generator during apply. Includes passive network and volume units. Empty for a file-only deployment. Ownership does not imply activation.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import quadlet_deployment.app app
```
